fundador.subtitle: Cycle Tourer · Founder · Developer
fundador.bio_p1: For 11 years I traveled 120,000 kilometers by bicycle across 84 countries. From the Pamir Mountains of Tajikistan to the temples of Luang Prabang in Laos, where I currently reside, I discovered that outdoor sports need digital tools that respect privacy, work offline, and belong to those who use them.
fundador.bio_p2: SportDharma Ecosystem was born from that need: a free, sovereign, offline-first software infrastructure for outdoor athletes. No algorithms, no tracking, no data selling. Just tools that accompany you on the road.
fundador.bio_p3: Today I combine life on the road with free software development, building tools that I use every day and share with the global community of conscious athletes.

home.fundador_desc: Cycle tourer, 120,000 km, 84 countries in 11 years. Currently in Luang Prabang, Laos. Certifications in AI, Digital Marketing and AI Product Management.
home.manifiesto_desc: From childhood books to cycling around the world. From Buddhism to AI. A search for purpose that became free infrastructure.
home.ecosistema_desc: Free, sovereign, offline-first infrastructure for outdoor athletes. Technology that respects your privacy and your environment.
home.pilares_desc: Sovereign Software, Transparent, Modular, Permanent Education, Solidarity, Ecological, Inclusive, Aligned Sustainability and Resilient.
home.app_title: Your offline companion on the road
home.app_desc: Topographic maps, GPS tracking and travel diary. Works 100% without internet, keeping your data under your total control.
home.web_desc: News, technical guides and organized resources. Installable as PWA, multi-language and fully functional offline.
home.masf_desc: Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture. Humans curate, AI assists. No opaque algorithms or hidden biases.
home.estado_desc: Base infrastructure construction phase. Preparing the application to the Proton Foundation Community Project with maximum quality and security.
home.noticias_desc: Fresh, verified and relevant content for the outdoor community, free from commercial biases and opaque algorithms.
home.herramientas_desc: Astro, Tailwind CSS, Vite PWA, and multi-agent architectures. Modern, lightweight and 100% open source stack.
home.apoya_desc: Your contribution keeps the infrastructure alive, without advertising or data selling. Grants and direct donations.
home.contacto_title: Want to contribute or contact us?
home.contacto_desc: We are looking for collaborators passionate about sports, sovereign technology and global well-being. Write to us.
home.comunidad_desc: Follow us on our digital platforms. Building together a global network of conscious athletes.
home.noticias_section_desc: Human curation, 6 daily publications. Fresh, verified and relevant content.
home.notif_desc: No emails, no registration, no tracking. Only native browser notifications.
home.rss_desc: The purest and most decentralized way to follow our news.
